source_title: Sequoia's Doug Leone on Building Enduring Companies in the AI Era | ElevenLabs Summit London 2026

clips.title: Go Experience A Problem (The Conference Room Startup Fallacy)
clips.hook: Why talking to 5 CIOs in a conference room scares Sequoia's Doug Leone
clips.quote: If you want to scare the shit out of me as an investor, tell me you and two friends got in a conference room and decided to talk to five CIOs to figure out what their problem was. Go experience a problem.

clips.title: Strategy Is Later: Get To 500 Customers First
clips.hook: You know what a great strategy is? Get to 500 customers.
clips.quote: Strategy is later. Right now: execution, execution, execution. You know what a great strategy is? Get to 500 customers! Sell, sell, sell. Once you get to 500 customers, we'll talk about positioning and Super Bowl ads.

clips.title: Most Board Members Are No-Ops (They Add Zero Value)
clips.hook: You're lucky if you get a no-op board member who does no damage.
clips.quote: Keep in mind that most board members—and this is going to shock you—are no-ops. You're lucky if you get a no-op board member. They do no damage, they add no value: zero. A great board member is a shock absorber.

clips.title: Architect Your Cap Table Like You Architect The Product
clips.hook: Don't brag about term sheets. Architect your cap table.
clips.quote: Architect your cap table the same way you architect the product. Don't give us this 'I got two term sheets'... Who cares? Align the equity early. Don't wake up 90 days in arguing over who owns what.
